title: Choosing Applications and Utility Software
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: What role does a device driver perform?
questions.answer: It lets the OS communicate with/control a specific hardware device.
options: There is not enough information to determine the result.

questions.feedback: Model answer: It lets the OS communicate with/control a specific hardware device.

questions.prompt: A linked-list node has data and what other essential field?
questions.answer: A link/reference to the next node (for a singly linked list).
options: A link/reference to the next node (for a singly linked record).
A link/reference to the next node (for a singly linked list).
A link/reference to the previous node (for a singly linked list).
questions.feedback: Model answer: A link/reference to the next node (for a singly linked list).

questions.prompt: In a BST, where is a value less than the current node placed?
questions.answer: In its left subtree (under the chosen no-duplicate convention).
options: In its left subtree (under the chosen no-duplicate convention).
In its right subtree (under the chosen no-duplicate convention).
There is not enough information to determine the result.
questions.feedback: Model answer: In its left subtree (under the chosen no-duplicate convention).

questions.prompt: Why can an array provide direct indexed access?
questions.answer: Its element locations can be calculated from base address and index.
options: Its element locations can be calculated from base address OR index.
Its element locations cannot be calculated from base address and index.
Its element locations can be calculated from base address and index.
questions.feedback: Model answer: Its element locations can be calculated from base address and index.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: application software — Programs that meet a user task.
utility — Software for maintenance, protection or optimisation.
backup — Recoverable copy to protect against data loss.

blocks.title: Clarify needs
blocks.text: Identify users, scale, accessibility, platform and constraints.

blocks.title: Match applications
blocks.text: Select task-specific tools: DBMS, spreadsheet, CAD, DTP, etc.

blocks.title: Understand utilities
blocks.text: Backup, compression, disk tools, antivirus and encryption maintain/protect systems.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model answer
blocks.text: A DBMS is better: structured records, querying, concurrency, constraints and access rights. A spreadsheet is useful for small-scale analysis but is not ideal as a multi-user transactional store. Check: link each claim to the scenario and use precise OCR terminology.
